EXAppExtensionBrowserViewController.doc: A view controller that displays an interface to enable or disable the host app’s extensions.

EXHostViewController.doc: A view controller that hosts remote views provided by an app extension.

EXHostViewControllerDelegate.doc: An interface you use to track the activation and deactivation of an app extension.

EXHostViewController.Configuration.doc: An object that holds configuration options for a host view controller.

configuration.doc: The information the host view controller uses to fetch the appropriate scene from an app extension.

delegate.doc: A custom delegate object you use to receive notifications about the activation and deactivation of the app extension.

makeXPCConnection().doc: Initiates an XPC connection to the app extension’s scene.

placeholderView.doc: The view to display when the view controller has no app extension content to display.
